---
metadata-files:

format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    mainfont: Arial
    sansfont: Arial
    fontsize: 11pt
    geometry:
      - margin=1in
    keep-tex: true
    fig-pos: H
  docx:
    reference-doc: templates/estevez_format.docx

    fig-dpi: 300
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
  fig-width: 6.5
  fig-height: 2.7
  fig-align: center
  out-width: 100%
editor: visual
---
